meta.name: The Church
meta.blurb: The priest preaches God's wrath; the dead need burying.

activities.name: Prayer and reflection
activities.blurb: Kneel in the cold of the nave, trade the priest a sin for a word in return, and listen for what answers.

activities.name: Do repair work
activities.blurb: The roof leaks, the tower leans, and the undercroft has been walled up longer than living memory. God's house needs hands.

activities.name: Talk to the flock
activities.blurb: Move among the frightened and the dying — carry water, close the eyes of the gone, and learn what the sickness is.
